scope: Verified only the PDF JBIG2 mapping against the locally supplied ISO 32000-2:2020 sponsored EC3 text, clause 7.4.7 and Table 12: bitonal data, page 1, embedded sequential organization, forbidden file/EOP/EOF structures and separate page-0 globals, including single-image use. The referenced optional marker encoding and all coding algorithms remain pending primary-text review of ISO/IEC 14492:2019 / ITU-T T.88 (2018); T.4/T.6 run coding is also pending. Exact PDFium comparisons are differential evidence, not standards verification. Resource budgets, stable unsupported tags and conservative handling of ambiguous page operators are documented project choices.

differential_observations.mmr-repeated: PDFium agrees with the horizontal-run oracle; Poppler preserves some preceding black runs on the final white row.
differential_observations.mmr-pass: PDFium agrees with the two pass operations and final vertical-zero oracle; Poppler preserves one black run.
differential_observations.page-default-operator: The initial default-AND interpretation disagreed with PDFium, Poppler and hayro, which rendered the region using its REPLACE operator. This combination remains explicitly unsupported with jbig2.page-combination pending review against the unavailable T.88 primary text. No alternative pixels are accepted as an oracle.
differential_observations.intermediate-generic-type: A new refinement reference vector exposed the former type-32 misreading shared by Rust and Python. Type 36 now represents intermediate generic bitmaps and type 32 is explicitly unsupported. PDFium agrees on the corrected reference/chain vectors; the T.88 type table remains pending primary-text review.
differential_observations.aggregation-strip-boundary: Multiple-symbol aggregates require completing the final coded strip before decoding the next dictionary field. PDFium agrees on both templates and on mixed single/multiple aggregation with shared integer/refinement state. High-level aggregation parameter conventions were also studied in hayro; no implementation code or tables were copied.

documented_choices: Limits and error categories follow ADRs 0003/0010; 7.4.7 does not prescribe numeric budgets.
Dictionary storage and retained bitmap contexts remain live until decoding completes; budget accounting is conservative and does not implement early frees.
A region operator conflicting with a fixed page default is unsupported pending the external primary text.
The decoder consumes segment headers directly and never consumes an optional standalone embedded marker; the marker byte values await external primary-text review.

differential_summary.method: Extracted decoded image bitmap without page resampling; compared all significant packed samples to the generator bitmap.
differential_summary.interpretation: Differential evidence only. Agreement with the generator does not verify ISO/IEC 14492 or T.88.

table_gate.huffman: Unsupported: no T.88 Huffman table has complete entry-by-entry independent bitmap evidence; no remembered table entries were enabled.
table_gate.patterns_and_halftones: Remain explicitly unsupported; no positive coding evidence was added for these modes.
table_gate.existing_mmr: PDFium exact bitmap evidence exercises every white/black terminating and makeup entry through mmr-terminating/mmr-makeup, plus pass and all vertical offsets; T.4/T.6 primary-text review is still pending.
